==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (vs. [[Hex spell|Hexed]] foes) 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Sunqua Blade]], [[dye]]d black.
